title: Armacell International S.A. | Luxembourg Aerogel Insulation Manufacturer
content:
Armacell International S.A. is a global insulation manufacturer whose public product messaging includes ArmaGel®, an aerogel-insulation range focused on thin-profile thermal control for demanding industrial environments. Public company materials position ArmaGel around high-performance blanket insulation for projects where space savings, hydrophobic behavior, and heat-loss control matter.

Company Overview

Armacell is widely known in the thermal and technical insulation market, and its ArmaGel line is presented as part of that broader insulation portfolio. The strongest public emphasis appears to be on industrial and energy-sector insulation rather than broad commodity building products, making the company relevant to buyers screening aerogel blanket suppliers for process equipment, piping, and retrofit work.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Global commercial reach through Armacell’s multinational insulation business.
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, space-constrained retrofits, hydrophobic thermal insulation systems, and low-thickness solutions for demanding process environments.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Public Product Reference: ArmaGel® aerogel insulation blanket grades marketed for industrial thermal-insulation use.
  • Public Product Family Reference: Public-facing materials commonly refer to ArmaGel grades such as HT and XGH, though exact current regional availability should be confirmed directly with Armacell.
  • Public Capacity: Specific aerogel production-capacity figures are not clearly disclosed on the reviewed public company materials available to this directory workflow.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Corporate Base: Luxembourg-based corporate identity with global manufacturing and insulation-market operations.
  • Supply Position: Public product messaging supports Armacell’s role as a commercial supplier of aerogel-insulation solutions through its broader insulation network.
  • Official Website: https://www.armacell.com/

FAQ

Why is Armacell included in the aerogel producer directory?

Armacell publicly markets the ArmaGel product family as aerogel insulation, making it a relevant commercial aerogel-insulation producer/supplier for industrial buyers.

What is the main ArmaGel focus?

Public product messaging most strongly emphasizes industrial thermal-insulation applications where reduced thickness, hydrophobic performance, and easier retrofit handling are valuable.

What should buyers verify directly?

Buyers should confirm exact product grade, service-temperature range, facing/jacketing options, and regional availability directly with Armacell before specification or procurement.
